method: Official YAMNet TFLite AudioSet event classification, 16 kHz mono analysis only; original stereo media untouched.
limitations: Automated scores are not calibrated probabilities, do not prove natural origin or rights, and do not replace human listening. No subjective listening was possible in this environment.

glow_selection.rule: Only candidates with Thunder maximum score >= 0.9 and at least 10 overlapping frames >= 0.5; strength intentionally subtle. Onsets come from 30–180 Hz energy rise, corroborated semantically within the surrounding 20 seconds. Onset precision is limited by the energy detector and 0.975-second classifier window; no subjective listening verification.
